about: Zone 7 (gantry, stairs): the chain that hangs beside the bow under the gantry (ChainAft, Hull bone) is six plain bars in SM_Airship. It is replaced by a heavy link chain built as detail geometry along the same line (SM_AirshipDetail_Z7_Chains, Hull bone), like reference 1's chains. Whole islands only: no open edges. ChainFwd is left as it is: it hangs inside the bow wedge (Z4) and does not show. No rail pieces are removed: the stairs arrive where the platform's aft edge has no rail.

edits.why: replace the ChainAft bars by a heavy link chain (detail object, Hull bone)
